items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: A critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) affects Adobe Commerce B2B.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type leading to RCE
items.summary: A critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVSS 9.3-9.6) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to upload dangerous file types and achieve arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Server-Side Template Injection
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated server-side template injection (SSTI) vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source leads to remote code execution and has been actively exploited as a zero-day.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including stored XSS and incorrect authorization flaws, which could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A critical stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A critical stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that allows unauthenticated account takeover and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to take over customer accounts and escalate privileges. This vulnerability has been actively exploited.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high severity stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high severity stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high severity stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) in Adobe Commerce could enable a security-feature bypass without authentication or administrator privileges.
